summary: Lake County, MT lookout cab in the Flathead NF, dated 1939 with a 1940 survey description; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab, filed as a ground structure rather than a tower
facts.status_note: Montana list marks it gone; firelookout.com gives no removal date or cause

events.note: firelookout.com dates the L-4 cab to 1939
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description places the Forest Service lookout house on the peak

evidence.supports: lookout house on a high bare peak about 7.5 miles NNE of Condon Ranger Station
evidence.quote: FOREST ON A HIGH BARE PEAK, 7-1/2 MILES NNE OF CONDON RANGER
DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1940 (ANS)

evidence.supports: Lake County; coordinates 47.69152 N, 113.70085 W; listed type Ground; status Gone

notes_for_editor: Three sources only: the firelookout.com page (1939 L-4 cab), the Forest Lookouts page (1940 survey description, Flathead NF, legal location 22N-16W-6) and the Montana list (Ground, Gone). No removal date, cause, staffing or fire found. The Forest Lookouts page shows 'Removed' beside the survey designation; it is unclear whether that refers to the survey mark or the lookout, so it is not used. No source states access, so access is omitted; the brief has it as unknown. The brief's agency and county agree with the sources; no corrections.
